name: Wrench
tagline: A garage log that tracks each vehicle's service and flags what is due next
description: Describe each vehicle in the driveway once, by VIN or by year, make and model, and it keeps a running service history, warns you before the next oil change or tyre rotation falls overdue, and helps you weigh a do-it-yourself fix with the right parts against booking a shop, towing questions included.

source.excerpt: Shared as a per-vehicle maintenance tracker that flags overdue service and weighs DIY parts against a shop visit.

body:
## What it does

Describe each vehicle in the driveway once, by VIN or by year, make and model, and it keeps a running service history, warns you before the next oil change or tyre rotation falls overdue, and helps you weigh a do-it-yourself fix with the right parts against booking a shop, towing questions included.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @treyvis shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
